summary: Arthur is a 1981 American comedy film written and directed by Steve Gordon. It stars Dudley Moore as Arthur Bach, a drunken New York City millionaire facing an arranged marriage to a wealthy heiress, who instead falls for a working-class girl from Queens. It was the only film Gordon directed, and he died in 1982 of a heart attack at age 44.
